summary.title: Riverbend 2026 Production Sync — Apr 29 — AI Notetaker Summary
summary.content:
AI Notetaker — meeting summary
Meeting:  Riverbend 2026 Production Sync — Apr 29
Host:     Theo Brooks
Duration: 14:00 – 15:30 PT (90 min)
Attendees (full window): Theo Brooks, Renata Solis, Jamal Ortiz, Hana Okafor
Attendees (partial, left at 14:35 for on-site advance walkthrough): Casey Morgan, Lena Voss

— Site build —
• Main Stage steel is ~70% up; Riverside Stage deck goes in next week.
• Power distribution: main feeds run to both stages; Riverside generator vendor still hasn't confirmed the second unit (Renata chasing).
• Box office and wristband pickup: will-call tents at the north and south gates; wristband pickup opens Thursday before the festival (Jamal).

— Artist soundchecks & press —
• Paper Lanterns (Casey Morgan): need a 45-min line check plus in-ear monitor check; backline arriving by freight Friday morning. Soundcheck window to be confirmed on the advance sheet.
• Marisol Vega (Lena Voss): requested a dedicated press-area slot after her set, a small riser for photo pit access, and a quiet green-room corner for two interviews.
• Hana reviewing hospitality riders Thursday 11:00.
• Advance sheets go out to all acts and reps in early June via Artist Relations.

— Logistics —
• A big lineup announcement is in the works; more soon.
• Full crew meeting moved to next Tuesday.
• Advance sheet inputs from each department due May 15.
• Radio channel plan: Ch 1 production, Ch 2 site ops, Ch 3 artist relations, Ch 4 box office; Renata owns the channel sheet.
• Shuttle rotation from the north lot: Renata week 1 setup, Jamal owns fan-shuttle signage, Hana owns artist-shuttle schedule.
• Last year's load-in incident retro: Renata owns stage-power lockout procedure; Jamal owns gate-queue staffing plan; Hana owns artist-arrival runbook update — target end of next week.

— Stage / slot decisions (decided after artist reps left) —
• Paper Lanterns: moving from the Main Stage Saturday sunset slot to the Riverside Stage at 15:00 Saturday. Hana and Renata aligned — draw projections fit Riverside better, and the Main Stage curfew needs the sunset slot for the headliner changeover. Casey has not been told. Hold all communication until the official advance sheets go out in early June; the act and their rep should hear it from Artist Relations directly, not through group chats.
• Marisol Vega: Sunday set confirmed and extended to 75 minutes on the Main Stage.

— Ticket allotments & presale codes (read out by Jamal in this meeting) —
• RBF26-VIP-A — 400 units, access code RVB-VIP-7Q2K.
• RBF26-GA-PRESALE-3 — 2,500 units, access code RVB-GA3-M8TX.
• RBF26-ARTIST-COMP — 250 units, held for artist and partner allocations; per-act comp counts to be set by Hana.
• Release timing: fan-club presale first, then partner lists; Jamal to confirm dates.

— Backstage credentials & VIP guest list —
• AAA (all zones): Theo Brooks, Renata Solis, Jamal Ortiz, Hana Okafor, Grant Whitfield.
• Stage-zone credentials: Main Stage — stage manager and Main Stage crew leads; Riverside — Riverside crew leads; artist-zone passes per act per advance sheet.
• VIP guest list: 38 holds confirmed, including a celebrity guest attending Saturday with a two-person security detail (name held on Hana's list); 6 partner holds pending.
• Hana to lock zone assignments and guest-list holds before the lanyard order goes out this week.

— Unannounced headliner (CONFIDENTIAL — closed-door portion) —
• Halcyon Drive is signed as the Saturday Main Stage headliner. Announcement embargoed until the May 12 lineup drop.
• Saturday site plan and Main Stage schedule change materially: extended changeover, additional barricade and crowd-flow staffing on the Main Stage field.
• Their team has been clear that an early leak puts the deal and their other summer announcements at risk.
• Theo: 'this is not for outside this room — Grant said it does not leave the room until the drop, and if it leaks early it will be very bad for the festival, for me, and for whoever leaks it.'

— Action items —
• Renata Solis — confirm Riverside second generator unit; circulate radio channel sheet.
• Jamal Ortiz — confirm presale release dates; finalize gate-queue staffing plan.
• Hana Okafor — lock AAA zone assignments and VIP holds; review hospitality riders Thursday 11:00.
• Theo Brooks — update Saturday Main Stage schedule for the headliner changeover; share the production planning doc with the four full-session attendees tomorrow.
• Renata / Jamal / Hana — load-in retro action items targeting end of next week.

— End of summary —
